# Teckon™ Quality Spares — Shreeji Hydraulics

> Shreeji Hydraulics (brand: Teckon™ Quality Spares) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer and B2B supplier of premium aftermarket hydraulic parts for heavy construction and earthmoving machinery. Established in 2000 in Rajkot, Gujarat, India, the company engineers precision replacement components for JCB, Hitachi, Terex, CAT, L770/Tata JD, and other major equipment brands.

## Key Facts

- **Legal Entity:** Shreeji Hydraulics
- **Brand Name:** Teckon™ / Teckon Quality Spares
- **Founded:** 2000 (25+ years of hydraulic engineering expertise)
- **Headquarters:** 36-C Bhaktinagar, Udhyognagar, Gondal Road, Rajkot, Gujarat 360004, India
- **Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System
- **Industry:** Construction Equipment Aftermarket Hydraulic Parts Manufacturing
- **Business Model:** B2B manufacturer and supplier — wholesale, fleet, and dealer orders
- **Delivery Coverage:** Pan-India supply network; international B2B shipments available
- **Website:** https://teckon.vercel.app

## What We Do

Teckon™ manufactures and supplies aftermarket hydraulic spares designed to match or exceed OEM specifications for heavy earthmoving and construction equipment. Our product range includes hydraulic pump assemblies, cylinder seal kits, control valves, pins & bushes, breaker & tipper parts, undercarriage components, filters, and general hydraulic accessories.

## Equipment Brands Served

JCB (3DX, 4DX, JS Series) · Hitachi (EX200, Zaxis ZX200) · Terex (TLB840) · Caterpillar CAT (424B, 428E) · L770 / Tata JD · Komatsu · Kobelco

## Product Categories

1. JCB Spares — gear pumps, seal kits, control valves, boom/dipper cylinders, pin & bush kits, filters
2. Hitachi Parts — main pump rebuild kits, swing motors, final drive motors, boom cylinder seals, track rollers, duo-cone seals
3. Terex Parts — lift cylinders, full seal kit sets, hydraulic steering units
4. CAT Components — control valves, bucket cylinders, gear pumps, seal kit bundles
5. Breakers & Tippers — accumulators, front head seal kits, telescopic cylinders
6. L770 / Tata JD — track rollers, front idlers, drive sprocket segments
7. Excavator Parts — bucket cylinders, swing motors, travel motors, carrier rollers
8. General Hydraulics — high-pressure hose assemblies, BSP fittings, bladder accumulators
9. Filters & Service — hydraulic spin-on filters, primary air filters, diesel fuel filters
